I registered and created the website Soundboard.Wiki -- http://www.soundboard.wiki -- where I installed a MediaWiki site, and uploaded the XML dump of all of the data from the defunct SoundboardPrankCalls.Wikia.com site that was available for download at the residual webpage there.

Unfortunately, the available XML dump files do not appear to include the images / media files from the defunct Wiki site, so only the contents of the articles -- as well as their edit histories in a certain format -- were able to be migrated to my new website as of the time of this posting. It is unclear to me at this time whether there might be any way to retrieve the images from the defunct site from Wikia.com or perhaps from any publicly-available Internet archiving services that may have crawled and archived the former site's contents.

If this is not possible, then the community would need to continue the Wiki with only the article contents and the edit histories migrated, and we would perhaps need to find new / replacement images for all of the articles over time. As of the time of this posting, I have paid for the domain name "Soundboard.Wiki" as well as the website hosting, completely out of my own pocket, because of how much I want to attempt to save the Soundboard Prank Calls Wiki from being lost to oblivion.
